head: codex/5780-delete-terminal-reconciliation
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][closeout] Delete competing terminal authorities
body:
## Outcome

- Deletes the standalone closeout and merge binaries, legacy receipt writers, terminal reconciliation/repair routes, readiness and merged-state writers, and obsolete writer-specific tests.
- Makes `csdlc-finish` the sole exact-head merge and derived-terminal authority; raw merge execution is private and cannot bypass validation, re-observation, or envelope retention.
- Preserves read-only compatibility for all 114 tracked v0.91.8 terminal records and 314 retained Git-common receipts.

## Reduction

- Production Rust: 28,722 -> 18,194 lines (-10,528; 36.65%).
- Test Rust: 15,092 -> 9,276 lines (-5,816; 38.54%).
- Combined Rust: 43,814 -> 27,470 lines (-16,344; 37.30%).
- Owner binaries: 23 -> 21.

## Validation

- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --locked`
- `cargo clippy --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- focused finish and terminal-authority deletion gates
- clean-room install and coexistence verification: 21 binaries, 11 skills, v2 default, no forbidden v1 paths
- independent exact-head review: PASS at `ce0994da07d2cdf349c658b1f8dee235814e5905`; typed metadata-only forward drift accepted by the publication guard

Closes #5780
